identification: Current Windows GPU name uniquely matched to the WebGPU adapter vendor
method: One paused initialization per scene in a dedicated worker. Includes scene building, GPU contact qualification, physics and rendering setup, and any initial support-validation step used to start an assembled stack asleep. Browser/driver caches may warm between scenes. These are startup times, not frame times. startupPhases identifies the setup work; preparing the first frame waits for GPU completion. firstFrameCompletedMs also includes page navigation and the final status check before the next scene starts.
